text: Following the teacher's instruction, she brought the desired fragrance of the smoke of puffed rice, held in her cupped palms, to his face. He, whose crest brushed against his cheeks, touched her lotus-like ears for a moment. Due to the inhalation of the smoke as per the custom, the bride's face became slightly moist with reddish lines on the cheeks, her eyes took on the hue of collyrium from sighing, and her barley-ornaments appeared drooping.
